add.Limits: Includes native dry-run forms. Staged content and index changes are outside this observation.

annotate.Limits: Explicit display modes retain native records.

blame.Limits: Retains line attribution and source text bytes.
Incremental and explicit display forms retain native records.

branch.Limits: Entries include Name, ObjectId, Current and Upstream.

check-attr.Limits: Uses NUL-delimited path, attribute and value triples. Supply explicit input for --stdin.
The newline-delimited input form keeps native output records.

check-ignore.Limits: Exit 1 means the predicate is false.
Supply -InputBytes for NUL input. QuietCli adapts literal paths to the NUL stdin form.
The newline display form keeps requested records.

check-ref-format.Limits: A valid ref needs no output. NormalizedName is populated when Git writes a name.

checkout.Limits: Local ref and HEAD observation. Worktree content and index changes are outside this observation.

checkout-index.Limits: Alternate destinations with --temp or --prefix are rejected. File contents are outside the observed scope.

cherry-pick.Limits: Includes local ref observations when available.

clean.Limits: Dry-run output is returned as requested records.
Actual removal is a native operation. Only observed worktree state is reported.

clone.Limits: Probes an explicit destination. Implicit clone destinations and recursive submodule state are outside the observation.

commit.Limits: Uses HEAD before and after. Supply an explicit message or interaction.

config.Limits: Reads configuration entries. Config values may be sensitive.
A lookup exit of 1 means no value.
Alternate display modes retain native records.
Reports native write status. Values are omitted from the projection.

count-objects.Limits: Uses the verbose numeric protocol in KiB.

describe.Limits: Parses the long form. Abbreviations do not prove full object IDs.
Custom suffix, contains and short forms use native records.

diff.Limits: Patch projection. --exit-code accepts native exit 1; inspect the native exit code.

diff-files.Limits: Uses the NUL-framed raw protocol with full IDs.

diff-index.Limits: Uses the NUL-framed raw protocol with full IDs.

diff-tree.Limits: Uses the NUL-framed raw protocol with full IDs.

fetch.Limits: Observes local refs affected by the fetch. The requested native operation may contact a remote.

for-each-ref.Limits: Entries include Name, ObjectId, Type and SymbolicTarget.
Custom formatting and quoting are native records.

grep.Limits: The predicate can be false with a successful QuietCli outcome.
Structured path results use NUL framing.

hash-object.Limits: Reports object identities. Supply input explicitly for --stdin. -w writes an object.

init.Limits: Probes the requested destination or working directory on success.

log.Limits: Commits include full object and parent IDs, author, committer, subject and body. Supply a count to bound the walk.
Explicit display forms retain native records.

ls-files.Limits: Stage mode includes mode, object ID and stage. Path entries preserve native bytes where needed.
Alternate report formats retain native records.

ls-remote.Limits: Native remote observation. --exit-code uses 2 for a missing match.

ls-tree.Limits: Projects mode, type, object ID, size and path through NUL framing.

merge.Limits: Conflicts and local ref changes reflect observed state.

merge-base.Limits: Exit 1 can indicate no common ancestor.
Native ancestry predicate. Exit 1 means false.

mv.Limits: Content and hook effects are outside the observation.

name-rev.Limits: Native labels can be undefined. Labels are separate from object IDs.
Custom display and stdin modes retain native records.

pull.Limits: Only local HEAD and refs are observed. Native integration and network behavior depend on the requested Git call.

push.Limits: Uses Git porcelain over Pipe. Reference acceptance is reported by Git.

read-tree.Limits: --index-output is rejected. Updates to worktree contents are outside the observed scope.

rebase.Limits: Interactive forms require explicit interaction or input.

reflog.Limits: Uses the requested native reflog walk. Old IDs are outside the projection.
Exit 1 means the reflog does not exist.
Explicit formats and non-show/exists operations retain native records.

remote.Limits: Returns configured fetch/push URLs from the local repository.
Preserves native requested records. remote show may query the remote.

reset.Limits: Local refs and worktree state are observed. Reset can discard changes.

restore.Limits: Reports observed index and worktree state.

rev-list.Limits: Typed object IDs and optional parents.
Counts, objects with paths and explicit display variations retain native records.

rev-parse.Limits: Use --verify for a typed object ID. A quiet miss has Found=false.
A single supported path, Boolean or format selector uses Pipe.
Other option-bearing forms use requested records. Bare positional input such as rev-parse HEAD currently fails in the handler.

revert.Limits: Conflicts and local ref changes reflect observed state.

rm.Limits: Content and hook effects are outside the observation.

shortlog.Limits: Groups preserve native labels and counts.
Without --summary the output remains native records.

show.Limits: For a non-blob using the default patch format.
A single object resolved as a blob produces an owned artifact. Release it in the same session.
The explicit format route applies when the object is not selected as a blob.

show-ref.Limits: Full references and object IDs. A quiet lookup uses the exit code for Found.
Requires a Git version with --exists. Distinguish absent and error by the native code.
Explicit short/hash formats retain native records.

stash.Limits: Entries contain Reference, ObjectId and Subject.
Observes local refs. Stash-induced file content changes are outside this scope.

status.Data: Repository, Branch, HeadOid, Counts, Entries, Operations, Profile, Digest, Diagnostics, Scope, AnswerComplete
status.Limits: Uses one structured result across display flags. Pipe required. Bare repositories and non-worktree positions return classified answers.
Omitted or unavailable values can be null. Inspect AnswerComplete and repository kind.

symbolic-ref.Limits: A quiet miss is reported with Exists=false.

tag.Limits: Projects tag name, object ID, type and peeled ID where available.
Explicit formatting and verification output retain native records.

update-index.Limits: Index stat flags and extensions are outside the observed projection.

version.Limits: BuildInformation contains the additional native lines when requested.

write-tree.Limits: Reports the native tree identity and may create a tree object.
